do: Minimum 4.5:1 ratio for normal text (large text 3:1)
dont: Low-contrast gray text on white or dark backgrounds

do: Visible focus rings on interactive elements (2-4px ring or equivalent)
dont: Remove focus rings with outline:none without replacement

do: Descriptive alt text for meaningful images; alt="" for decorative
dont: Omit alt attribute entirely; use filename as alt text

do: aria-label for icon-only buttons; accessibilityLabel in native apps
dont: Icon-only controls with no label — screen reader says button only

do: Tab order matches visual order; all interactive elements keyboard reachable
dont: Trapping focus; skip links absent; custom widgets not keyboard-operable

do: Use label with htmlFor or wrap input; visible labels always
dont: Placeholder as only label — disappears on focus

do: Supplement color with icon or text for status/error/success
dont: Red border alone to indicate error — fails for colorblind users

do: Respect prefers-reduced-motion; reduce or disable animation
dont: Ignoring reduced-motion preference and forcing full animation

do: Sequential h1 through h6; never skip levels
dont: Jump from h1 to h4; use headings purely for styling

do: Support system text scaling; avoid truncation as text grows
dont: Capping font size scaling with maxFontSizeMultiplier=1 everywhere

do: Minimum 44x44pt (Apple) or 48x48dp (Material); use hitSlop if icon is smaller
dont: Small 24pt icon buttons with no expanded hit area

do: Minimum 8px gap between adjacent touch targets
dont: Two buttons touching with no gap — causes mis-taps

do: Provide pressed feedback (ripple/opacity/elevation) within 80-150ms
dont: No visual change on tap — user doubts action registered

do: Primary interactions on tap/click; don't rely on hover alone for key actions
dont: Hover-only tooltips or menus with no tap alternative on mobile

do: Disable button during async; show spinner or progress indicator
dont: No loading state — user taps multiple times; duplicate submissions

do: One primary gesture per region; avoid nested tap/drag conflicts
dont: Horizontal swipe list inside vertical scrollview — gesture fights

do: Keep tap targets away from notch Dynamic Island home indicator edges
dont: Primary button overlapping home indicator on iPhone

do: Use platform standard gestures consistently
dont: Redefining swipe-back or pinch-zoom to do something unexpected

do: Use WebP/AVIF responsive images with srcset/sizes; expo-image in React Native
dont: Large unoptimized PNG/JPG with no lazy loading

do: Declare width and height or use aspect-ratio to prevent layout shift
dont: Images without dimensions — causes CLS during load

do: Use font-display: swap to avoid invisible text (FOIT)
dont: No font-display — text invisible until font loaded (FOIT)

do: Lazy load non-hero components via dynamic import or route-level splitting
dont: Import all components eagerly at root — large initial bundle

do: Virtualize lists with 50+ items (FlashList react-window content-visibility)
dont: ScrollView with .map() over large arrays — causes jank and memory pressure

do: Avoid reading layout properties (getBoundingClientRect offsetHeight) during render
dont: Interleaving DOM reads and writes in a loop — forces layout thrashing

do: Keep per-frame work under ~16ms for 60fps; move heavy tasks off main thread
dont: Synchronous heavy computation in render or scroll handler

do: Use skeleton screens or shimmer for operations > 300ms
dont: Long blocking spinner with no content preview

do: Debounce/throttle high-frequency events (scroll resize input)
dont: Search triggering API on every keystroke — rate-limiting and lag

do: Match UI style to product type and audience expectations
dont: Brutalism for a healthcare app; skeuomorphism for a SaaS dashboard

do: Use one style consistently across all screens and components
dont: Mixing glassmorphism on one screen and brutalism on another

do: Use SVG vector icons (Heroicons Lucide react-native-vector-icons)
dont: Emoji as navigation icons or status indicators

do: Use a consistent elevation/shadow scale; define tokens (elevation-1 to elevation-5)
dont: Random shadow values on different cards in the same product

do: Design light and dark together; verify contrast independently in both
dont: Inverting light colors for dark mode without redesigning contrast ratios

do: width=device-width initial-scale=1 in meta tag; never disable zoom
dont: user-scalable=no or maximum-scale=1 — fails accessibility

do: Design for 375px first then scale up to tablet and desktop
dont: Desktop-first design crammed onto mobile — usability failure

do: No horizontal scroll on mobile; all content fits within viewport width
dont: Content overflowing horizontally — broken on mobile

do: Use 4pt/8dp incremental spacing system consistently
dont: Random spacing values — inconsistent visual rhythm

do: Fixed nav/bottom bar reserves padding so scroll content is not hidden
dont: Scrollable content hidden behind fixed sticky element

do: Use min-h-dvh instead of 100vh on mobile
dont: 100vh on mobile causes content cut off by browser UI chrome

do: 1.5 to 1.75 for body text; 1.2 to 1.4 for headings
dont: Line-height 1.0 or 1.1 on body text — too cramped to read

do: Minimum 16px body text on mobile to avoid iOS auto-zoom
dont: 12px body text on mobile — triggers iOS auto-zoom and fails readability

do: Use a consistent type scale (e.g. 12 14 16 18 24 32)
dont: Arbitrary font sizes on every component — no visual rhythm

do: Define semantic color tokens (primary error surface on-surface)
dont: Raw hex values hardcoded in component styles

do: Bold headings (600-700) regular body (400) medium labels (500)
dont: All text same weight — no visual hierarchy

do: Use tabular/monospaced figures for number columns prices and timers
dont: Proportional figures in data tables — numbers shift as values change

do: 150-300ms for micro-interactions; complex transitions ≤ 400ms
dont: Animations longer than 500ms on interactive feedback

do: Animate transform and opacity only (compositor properties)
dont: Animating width height top left margin — causes layout reflow per frame

do: Every animation expresses cause-effect or spatial relationship
dont: Decorative animations that spin or pulse without semantic meaning

do: Use spring/physics-based curves for natural feel
dont: Linear easing for UI transitions — feels mechanical and cheap

do: Animations must be cancellable; user tap stops in-progress animation
dont: Animation locks UI for its duration — input blocked during transition

do: UI stays fully interactive during any animation
dont: Blocking tap/input during page transition animation

do: Visible label above or beside every input field
dont: Placeholder as sole label — disappears on focus causing memory failure

do: Show error message directly below the field that failed
dont: Error summary only at top of page with no field-level indicator

do: Validate on blur (field loses focus) not on each keystroke
dont: Showing errors while user is still typing the first character

do: Show loading spinner then success/error state after submit
dont: No feedback after submit — user cannot tell if action completed

do: After submit with errors auto-focus the first invalid field
dont: Page stays scrolled to bottom; user must hunt for red fields

do: Error message includes what went wrong AND how to fix it
dont: Error says only Invalid input with no guidance

do: Reveal complex options progressively; show only essential fields first
dont: Presenting 20-field form on first screen — overwhelming

do: Bottom navigation maximum 5 items; always include icon and text label
dont: 6+ items in bottom nav — crowded; icon-only nav without labels

do: Back navigation predictable and consistent; preserves scroll and state
dont: Back navigates to wrong screen; scroll position reset; state lost

do: All key screens reachable via deep link URL for sharing and notifications
dont: No deep link config — push notification opens home screen only

do: Modals and sheets have clear close affordance; swipe-down to dismiss
dont: Modal with no close button; swipe-down not supported on sheet

do: Back navigation restores scroll position filter state and input values
dont: Back clears all filters and resets scroll to top — frustrating UX

do: Large screens (≥1024px) use sidebar; small screens use bottom or top nav
dont: Same bottom nav on iPad as iPhone — wastes space and looks wrong

do: Match chart type to data type: trend=line comparison=bar proportion=donut
dont: Pie chart for 10+ categories; bar chart for continuous time series

do: Always show legend positioned near chart not hidden below scroll fold
dont: Legend below the fold; legend absent entirely

do: Tooltips on hover (web) or tap (mobile) showing exact values with units
dont: No tooltip — user cannot read precise values from visual only

do: Use accessible palette that works for color-blind users; supplement with pattern
dont: Red/green only color distinction for pass/fail data — fails colorblind

do: Show meaningful empty state when no data (no data yet + guidance)
dont: Empty axis frame with no data and no explanation

do: Charts reflow or simplify on small screens (horizontal bar fewer ticks)
dont: Full-width desktop chart rendered identically on 375px phone
